mac_notes: Support and Tickets: the View user panel now shows song status history, deletion history, and a Warn Artist action, matching Moderation. Ban Artist now requires a reason before it can be submitted.
windows_notes: Fixed sort order in Support and Tickets only being correct on the first page (also affected Support's bulk select-all), missing Claude Context defaults, the Apple Music Style Guide reference, invisible Composer lists, Streaming Fraud/Spotify Claim actions, a Reply with Claude context mix-up between customers, the DevTools window opening on every launch, an update installer failure, a black console window popping up on notifications, a wrong ticket-count range in Support, and duplicate select-all buttons in Support/Tickets/Mail. Fixed Support ticket pages sometimes taking over a minute to load, the open-ticket reconciliation sync being slow and occasionally leaving stale tickets open, the quoted previous thread not being editable when forwarding an email, Shift+Click not selecting a range of songs in Moderation for takedowns, Settings closing on its own when switching tabs, Select-all delete in Mail only deleting a small leftover subset, and the Drafts/Sent sidebar counts showing unread instead of total. Added song preview-play in Moderation, widened automatic backups to cover uploaded files, and added automatic database repair on launch if it's ever found corrupted.
